title: Import project JSON
js: const input=root.querySelector('[data-input]'),status=root.querySelector('[data-status]'); const validate=x=>x&&x.version===1&&typeof x.timestamp==='string'&&typeof x.title==='string'&&Array.isArray(x.cards)&&x.cards.every(v=>typeof v==='string'); root.querySelector('[data-import]').addEventListener('click',()=>{let parsed;try{parsed=JSON.parse(input.value);}catch{status.textContent='ERROR: invalid JSON. Current state was not changed.';return;}if(!validate(parsed)){status.textContent='ERROR: expected version 1, timestamp, string title, and string[] cards. Current state was not changed.';return;}api.setState('title',parsed.title);api.setState('cards',[...parsed.cards]);status.textContent=`Imported: ${parsed.title} (${parsed.cards.length} cards).`;});
